task.description: Implement ADP-07 in backend code and migrations according to src/design/adp-07-agent-role-reserved-usernames.md. Add AGENT_RUNNER as a grantable role while preserving existing role behavior. Enforce reserved username prefix agent: so non-PLATFORM_ADMIN actors are rejected from creating agent identities, while PLATFORM_ADMIN creation path remains allowed. Preserve existing identity and role behavior for non-agent users. Add or update tests needed for acceptance coverage and regression protection.
acceptance_criteria: AGENT_RUNNER role exists and is grantable without regressing existing role matrix behavior
Non-PLATFORM_ADMIN actor cannot create usernames with agent: prefix
PLATFORM_ADMIN actor can create usernames with agent: prefix
All required backend validations pass: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate
No security regressions: no SQL interpolation, no secrets in source, typed error handling preserved

result.summary: Implemented ADP-07 backend changes by adding AGENT_RUNNER role support in auth/token flows, enforcing reserved agent: username policy in identity service (admin-only creation and non-admin/JIT rejection), adding additive migration 034 to seed AGENT_RUNNER, and adding ADP-07 integration coverage for role seed/token issuance and reserved-username enforcement.
